methodology.scope: Contextual discovery links between ATT&CK Enterprise and public Cyber Knowledge modules.

confidence.explicit-id: The module contains the ATT&CK identifier.
confidence.explicit-name: The module contains the full technique name.
confidence.topic-match: Technique name/description, tactic, and governed domain vocabulary overlap.
confidence.tactic-route: Fallback route from the technique tactic to a practitioner module.

methodology.warning: Mappings are navigation aids, not evidence of actor use, control coverage, detection efficacy, or compromise.
